title: DP-MERF + Voting: Differentially Private Synthetic Tabular Data Generation
summary: A research project that augments the DP-MERF differentially private generator with a nearest-neighbour histogram voting post-processing step to improve utility of synthetic tabular data on datasets like Adult, Census and Credit, evaluated under formal (ε, δ)-DP guarantees. The repository imports sdgym to load its benchmark tabular datasets and separately carries an in-tree copy of CTGAN's synthesizer as one of several baseline generative methods.
